Class SessionUtil

java.lang.Object
com.example.tarecruitment.common.web.SessionUtil
public class SessionUtil extends Object
SessionUtil - Session utility class. After login, session saves both `user` object and some basic fields. New code preferentially reads `user` object; string fields are mainly for JSP fragments and legacy utility method compatibility.
